title: Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains
abstract: arXiv:2608.07474v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains once AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is V x L, where L is per-item cognitive load: triage, judgment, and response. These components respond asymmetrically to capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, largely by inducing omission. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. We prove a proposition: if V x L grows at any positive compound rate while supervisory capacity grows linearly, exceedance occurs in finite time; capacity investment buys time only logarithmically, while reducing the growth rate extends it hyperbolically. translated_title: 逐流治理：高损失领域中AI输出的内容判断旁路机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07474v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：先前研究表明，在AI输出速度V超过人类认知能力C_max的高损失领域中，人类介入监督在结构上变得不可持续。然而，关键约束是V乘以L，其中L是每项任务的认知负荷：分类、判断和响应。这些组成部分对能力提升的响应不对称。分类成本不会下降，因为语义不确定性是通用设计的内在属性。响应成本与准确性无关。只有判断成本面临下行压力，主要通过诱导遗漏实现。因此，能力提升会重构L而非减少它。我们证明一个命题：如果V乘以L以任何正复合增长率增长，而监督能力线性增长，则超限在有限时间内发生；能力投资只能对数性地争取时间，而降低增长率则能双曲线地延长时间。因此，监督增强和流量控制是互补而非替代策略。
tldr: 本文证明在高损失领域中，AI输出速度与认知负荷的乘积呈正复合增长必然导致监督超限，而判断成本下降仅通过遗漏实现，故需引入内容判断旁路机制来治理AI输出。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in high-loss domains, the product of AI output velocity and cognitive load growing at a positive compound rate inevitably leads to supervision exceedance, and judgment cost reduction only occurs via omission, thus necessitating a content-judgment bypass mechanism for governing AI output.
